peony.title: Peony/Flow
peony.author: Idan Gafni
peony.notes:
Peony Flow is a simple yet smart profile for uneven extraction from Nordic style roasts to Medium roasts to reduce roast flavors. 

Adaptation to your coffee and setup:
Reduce flow in last flow stage for lower uniformity burrs if you don't like the result and see many channels in your extraction (low extraction)
Change pause time as blooming for higher extraction (through contact time)

push.title: Push/MaX-Traction
push.author: Idan Gafni
push.notes: 25+ EY. High extraction low body beverage. Requires grinding of about 200+ microns from burrs lock. This profile is a dedicated profile to light roasted coffees that are more challenging to extract. The increased extraction is achieved by using various extraction mechanics such as multiple fills with fresh water,multiple blooms, and contact time. With high flow baskets (unibasket, sworks flow, wafo soe, pesado etc) it will drizzle throughout the extraction.

push.title: Push/NotSoTurbo
push.author: Idan Gafni
push.notes: 19-21/22 EY with 1:2 ratio and lower. Aimed for darker light roasts, drum roasts, fermented processing. Not an even extraction by design. Based on experiments that showed the turbo concept can produce optimized results when the profile is flow based and not pressure based (so no turbo flow in the end).

tanat.title: Kawa/Witch HUnt Turbo
tanat.author: Idan Gafni
tanat.notes: This profile is based on the Hendon turbo shot concept appropriate for the HU burrs and simulates a Bezzera Strega lever machine manually manipulated to increase EY. It imitates the technique I developed with my lever machine after years of lever manipulation iterations to satisfy my need for good espresso base for dry cappuccino. The gradual water filling combined with a blooming phase enables good saturation throughout the puck. Standard flow rates with this profile are usually 1.5-3.5 ml/s with most beans Strega in Italian translates to a witch so hopefully you get magical cups with this profile.

tanat.title: Kawa/Witch HUnt Turbo (bloom)
tanat.author: Idan Gafni
tanat.notes:
This Kawa profile is intended to serve Nordic roasted coffee that is not difficult to extract but challenges in terms of avoiding roastiness flavors.
Witch HUnt family of profiles is intended to imitate lever manipulations performed with coffee that is ground with High Uniformity particle distribution.

hmc.title: HMC/FlowHUCB18
hmc.author: Idan Gafni
hmc.notes:
HMC Flow is a simple yet smart profile for uneven extraction from HMC style roasts. 

Adaptation to your coffee and setup:
Adjust fill stages according to basket with lower target pressure exit conditions for high flow baskets or higher ones for classic baskets
Reduce flow in last flow stage for lower uniformity burrs if you don't like the result and see many channels in your extraction (low extraction)
Change pause time as blooming for higher extraction (through contact time)
Increase flow to get less even extraction

cleaning.title: Cleaning/Thorough Forward Flush
cleaning.author: Idan Gafni
cleaning.notes: A convenient way to perform a cleaning routine of the group head. Based on the forward flush X5 with some tweaks. (1) Put a blind basket in your portafilter  (2) Put 3g (1/2 teaspoon) of espresso machine detergent in the blind basket  (3) Run this profile  (4) When it is done, remove the portafilter off Flush the DE1 until the water goes clear  (5) Put the portafilter back without detergent and run this profile again  (6) Finally, run FLUSH for 20 seconds.
